mod.name: C&N Jewelry
mod.text:
Rough/cut gems, encrusting armor/tools with buffs, and gem extraction.

A full gem-cutting and socket-encrustment system for Vintage Story. Pan and mine rough gems, cut them at a gem cutting table, grind them on a jewel grinder, and encrust them into the sockets of your armor, tools and weapons — granting stat buffs while equipped. Extract gems from old gear and swap them at will.

Want wearable jewelry — rings, tiaras, necklaces, monocles, earrings and display stands for them? Add the companion mod C&N Jewelry Adornments. This mod is the core system it builds on.

What’s in the mod

  • Gem cutting table - chip a rough gem down to a round, baguette or pear cut, voxel by voxel.
  • Mechanical jewel grinder - connect mechanical power, drop a grindlayer, and refine your cut gems through up to three grinding steps for significantly higher buff values.
  • Socket encrustment - armor, tools and weapons carry sockets by tier; set a cut gem into one and wear the buff.
  • Jeweler’s table - a workstation with its own dialog: drop in an item, rotate its preview, see every socket colour-coded by tier, and slot in the gems that fit.
  • Knapster-style cutting settings - server-side accessibility options for the cutting table, editable in a GUI.
  • Iron & steel pans - pan ore chunks of every metal type to extract rough gems.
  • Wire drawing bench - draw metal wire hanks used in jewelry crafting recipes.
  • Gem extraction - chisel a gem back out of its socket to re-use it or swap it for another. Both the gem and the item have a chance to survive intact.
  • Extra jewelry inventory slots - dedicated character slots for rings, earrings and nose rings, filled by the Adornments companion mod.
  • In-game guide dialog (press J) - color-coded stat tables with per-tier value ranges, socket-tier reference, cut-style comparison, and a full panning drop table by ore type and quality.

Cut styles

Round
Primary stat only.
Highest main-stat after full grinding (~×2.19 of base). Best long-term choice.		 Baguette
Primary stat (~×1.99 fully ground) + a random secondary buff from a stat-specific pool. Trades some main-stat power for a bonus stat.		 Pear
Primary stat only, but front-loaded ×1.7 without grinding. Round overtakes it after full processing — good for un-ground gems.

Socket tiers

T1 — Bronze   tin / bismuth / black bronze socket, chipped (small) gems

T2 — Gold / Silver / Iron   meteoric iron also fits, flawed (medium) gems

T3 — Steel   normal (large) gems

Cutting accessibility settings

Open the settings dialog with /canjewelry cutting gui (requires the controlserver privilege). Everything is also available as plain commands under /canjewelry cutting.

Voxels per click
cutting voxels 1-8		 How many chisel strikes a single click performs, in 1x1 tool mode. Turns a hundred clicks into a dozen.
Durability per voxel
cutting durability true/false		 Whether every strike of a multi-strike click costs chisel durability, or the click only costs one.
Instant complete
cutting instant true/false		 Finish the selected cut on the very first strike. The full skip, for players who want the gems without the voxel work.
Spare recipe voxels
cutting spare true/false		 Line and area tool modes skip over voxels the recipe still needs, so a stray drag cannot ruin the gem.
Hold to strike
cutting hold 0-2000		 Milliseconds between strikes while the attack button is held down. Hold instead of clicking; 0 switches it off.
Who it applies to
cutting mode ...		 disabled - off for everyone (vanilla cutting) · enabled - on for everyone · whitelist - only for named players · blacklist - everyone except named players. Names are managed with cutting whitelist <name> / cutting blacklist <name>, or in the dialog.

/canjewelry cutting with no arguments prints the current settings.

Companion mods

  • C&N Jewelry Adornments - 12+ wearable jewelry items with metal variants, plus necklace and headware display stands.
  • C&N Jewelry × XSkills - two XSkills progression skills:
    • Lapidary - perks for panning yield, material efficiency, grinding speed and quality. The Prospector perk unlocks additional rock types that can be panned for gems.
    • Jeweler - perks for encrusting buff strength, wire drawing, and gem extraction. Extract License unlocks gem removal; higher-tier perks improve the odds of keeping the gem and the item intact.
  • Example mod for modders 

Integrations

Has integration with rough gems from Geology Additions.

Compatible with:

  • Titanium-steel Tools (partial)
  • Swordz
  • Blackguard Additions
  • All Forgotten Armory mods

Videos

  • C&N Jewelry #1 - Rough gems, drop tables and panning
  • Gem cutting (revisited)
  • 0.5.15 Panning for gems
